title: Canvas page spec
description: Authored Canvas page format. Workbench normalizes this into an @json-render/react-compatible spec by synthesizing the canvas:component-tree root wrapper.

$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema reference for editor tooling.

uuid.description: Page UUID. Used to match local pages with their remote counterparts.

title.description: Page metadata. Workbench may surface this separately from the normalized @json-render/react-compatible spec.

pageVariant.description: Machine name of the page variant (page template) rendering this page. Omitted means the site default.

elements.description: Authored page elements. Workbench preserves key insertion order when synthesizing canvas:component-tree children.
